text.what: Russian-born, Paris-trained, and the winemaker most often credited with teaching post-Prohibition California what a cellar is for. He is remembered for cabernet, and he also argued for cold ground — Carneros among it.

kin.as: The cold shoulder he pointed people toward.
A contemporary experiment in importing Burgundian cellar practice.
